title: Tell Me You're A Werewolf
trend: TikTok 'Tell me you're X without telling me you're X' (quick proof of an identity, ending on a look; Peaking, top 4.7M, Postdom TikTok trends week of Nov 23-29 2026, US) + the full beaver supermoon (Google Trends US past 24h, 'full moon supermoon' 20K+, related 'beaver moon meaning', Nov 24 2026) + meeting the family the night before Thanksgiving — Wanda brings boyfriend Brett home under the full moon and Grandpa Otto quizzes him, 'tell me you're a werewolf without telling me'; every answer sounds worse (perfect hearing, fur on his sweater, dog treats in every pocket, gone every full moon at midnight) while the family dog Waffles narrates; twist: Brett is a dog groomer who runs a midnight moon-watching club — and the real werewolf is Grandpa Otto, who 'goes bowling in the woods' every full moon; button: Otto books Brett for a once-a-month house call — breed: Grandpa
youtube_title: Grandpa thinks my boyfriend is a werewolf. The full moon disagrees 🌕
description:
Wanda brings Brett home to meet the family on the night of the full moon. Grandpa Otto has questions. Brett has fur on his sweater and treats in every pocket. Waffles the dog knows the truth.

#cartoon #animation #funny #fullmoon #shorts
tiktok_caption: tell me you're a werewolf without telling me you're a werewolf 🌕 #cartoon #animation #funny #fullmoon

lines.text: Grandpa, this is Brett. Please be nice. Tonight is a full moon and you get weird.
Brett. Tell me you are a werewolf without telling me you are a werewolf.
Sir, I am not a werewolf. I am a guy named Brett.
I am Waffles. I am the dog. I smell a werewolf in this room.
Question one. How is your hearing?
Great. I can hear the fridge opening from upstairs. I love that sound.
Interesting. Very interesting.
Everybody can hear the fridge, Grandpa. It has a squeak.
Question two. Why is your sweater covered in fur?
Oh. That is not mine. That is from about forty other dogs.
He has dog treats in every pocket. Every pocket. I have checked them all.
I like to be prepared. You never know when you will meet a good boy.
I am a good boy. I have decided to trust him.
Question three. Where do you go on the full moon?
Every full moon, at midnight, I go outside with my friends.
And what do you do outside with your friends?
We look up at the moon. Sometimes we make a little noise.
Brett. Babe. That is not helping.
Wanda, step away from him. Slowly. Waffles, guard the turkey.
I have been guarding the turkey since Tuesday. Nobody asked me to.
Sir, I can explain everything. I am a dog groomer.
The fur is from work. The treats are from work. I had a poodle at five.
And the moon at midnight?
I run a moon watching club. It is me and three retired teachers. We bring soup.
The little noise is Miss Patterson. She says wow at the moon.
Every month. Like she has never seen it before. It is beautiful.
Fine. Maybe you are not a werewolf.
He is not. But somebody in this house is.
Waffles, what are you talking about?
Tell me Grandpa is a werewolf without telling me Grandpa is a werewolf.
Every full moon, he says he goes bowling. In the woods.
There is no bowling alley in the woods.
It is a very small bowling alley. It is mostly trees.
He comes home at sunrise and sleeps in my bed. I sleep in his recliner.
Sir, that is why you asked all the questions.
A man has to check. It is lonely being the only one.
Grandpa, it is a full moon. It is almost midnight.
Do not worry. I am very polite. I wipe my paws.
He does. He also sheds on everything. The couch looks like me now.
Brett. You are a dog groomer. Do you do house calls?
I do. How often?
Once a month. At midnight. Bring the big brush.
Sure. And what breed is it?
Grandpa.
He will need a lot of treats. Bring every pocket.
